about: Prices per year read per month, power in watts read in kilowatts: factors the build supplies.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 2
model: tiny
title: Conversions
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  price_per_tb_year:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: USD/TB/year
    value: 120
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "a quoted price, stated for this case"}

  price_per_tb_month:
    kind: derived
    unit: USD/TB/month
    formula: price_per_tb_year

  host_power:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: W/host
    value: 400
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "a spec sheet, stated for this case"}

  hosts:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: host
    value: 20
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  fleet_power:
    kind: derived
    unit: kW
    formula: hosts * host_power

  hours_per_year:
    kind: input
    decided: definition
    unit: hour/year
    value: 8766
    provenance: {kind: fact, source: "definition: 365.25 days of 24 hours"}

  energy:
    kind: derived
    unit: MWh/year
    formula: fleet_power * hours_per_year

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - price_per_tb_month
  - energy
